rule.coverage_conditions: All cities and towns in Massachusetts. A city or town that accepts Chapter 40P may adopt rent control regulation; such regulation may not reach units of owners of fewer than ten rental units or units with fair market rent over $400.

rule.title: Massachusetts notice to terminate tenancy at will
rule.requirement: Either party may end a tenancy at will with three months' written notice; if rent is payable at intervals shorter than three months, notice equal to the payment interval or 30 days, whichever is longer, suffices. Nonpayment allows 14 days' notice to quit, with a 10-day right to cure.
rule.key_value: 3 months' notice; 30 days or payment interval if shorter; 14 days for nonpayment
rule.coverage_conditions: Tenancies at will in Massachusetts; the section states no building, unit or owner limits.
rule.exemptions: A tenant who received a similar notice to quit within the preceding 12 months has no right to prevent termination by paying the rent due.
rule.penalty: If a nonpayment notice omits the required notification, the tenant's cure period is extended to the day the answer is due in an eviction action.
rule.quoted_span: Estates at will may be determined by either party by three months' notice in writing for that purpose given to the other party; and, if the rent reserved is payable at periods of less than three months, the time of such notice shall be sufficient if it is equal to the interval between the days of payment or thirty days, whichever is longer.

rule.penalty: Liable for damages of not less than one month's rent nor more than three months' rent, or actual damages if greater, plus costs and a reasonable attorney's fee.

rule.title: Initiative Petition 25-21 to limit rent increases
rule.requirement: Would have protected tenants by limiting rent increases. The Supreme Judicial Court held the petition contained excluded matters and enjoined the Secretary of the Commonwealth from placing it on the 2026 ballot.
rule.quoted_span: The matter is remanded to the county court, where a judgment shall enter declaring that Initiative Petition 25-21 contains excluded matters in violation of art. 48, and enjoining the Secretary of the Commonwealth from taking steps to place the measure on the ballot for the 2026 Statewide election.
